# Hermes Agent — Česká komunita (Czech AI Community)

> Hermes Agent is an open-source autonomous AI agent by Nous Research. This is a community website providing installation guides, comparisons, tutorials, and a blog about running Hermes Agent on VPS, Telegram, Discord, and more. Available in Czech and English.

This site helps Czech and Slovak users get started with Hermes Agent. It covers everything from basic concepts to advanced deployment and automation. All content is dual-language (CS/EN); the language of the first visit is chosen by the server from the `Accept-Language` header. 27 articles in each language. Last verified against the live site: 2026-10-15.

## Docs

- [What is Hermes Agent](https://hermes-ai.cz/): Main landing page with overview, features, and comparison table
- [What is Hermes (detail)](https://hermes-ai.cz/co-je-hermes/): What the agent is and how it works
- [Features](https://hermes-ai.cz/funkce/): Tools, memory, skills, MCP and automation
- [Installation Guide](https://hermes-ai.cz/instalace/): Complete step-by-step installation for Linux, macOS, WSL2, Windows
- [VPS Hosting](https://hermes-ai.cz/hosting/): Contabo VPS comparison and pricing for AI agents
- [Skills Overview](https://hermes-ai.cz/skills/): All available agent skills, agentskills.io compatibility
- [FAQ](https://hermes-ai.cz/faq/): Frequently asked questions about pricing, installation, platforms
- [Community](https://hermes-ai.cz/komunita/): Discord server, reaction roles and community resources

## Blog

- [Blog main page](https://hermes-ai.cz/blog/): 27 articles about Hermes Agent, 3 pages of content
- [Install Hermes on Ubuntu](https://hermes-ai.cz/blog/clanek/instalace-hermes-agent-ubuntu/): 60-second installation guide

- [Telegram Bot Setup](https://hermes-ai.cz/blog/clanek/telegram-bot-hermes-agent/): Create a Telegram bot in 5 minutes
- [Local LLM with Ollama](https://hermes-ai.cz/blog/clanek/hermes-agent-ollama-lokalni-llm/): Run Hermes with free local models
- [OpenRouter Integration](https://hermes-ai.cz/blog/clanek/hermes-agent-openrouter/): Access 300+ models with one API key
- [Security Guide](https://hermes-ai.cz/blog/clanek/bezpecnost-hermes-agent/): Protect your server and API keys
- [Cron Scheduler](https://hermes-ai.cz/blog/clanek/hermes-agent-cron-planovac/): 24/7 automation with Hermes
- [MCP Integration](https://hermes-ai.cz/blog/clanek/hermes-agent-mcp-integration/): Model Context Protocol setup
- [WebUI Guide](https://hermes-ai.cz/blog/clanek/hermes-webui-pruvodce/): Complete web interface setup

## WebMCP Tools

This site exposes WebMCP tools for AI agents (on the two landing pages):

- **find_hermes_guide** — Navigate to relevant guides: installation, VPS hosting, skills overview, FAQ, or blog articles.
